limits: Ordinary fixed 20-day (or explicit CLI day count) window. Versions chosen at world creation. No inserted occasions, goods or decisions. Counts describe divergent worlds, not paired event opportunities or general household benefit. Arrival already grants the existing meeting/mood/exchange consequences; completion means staying through the bounded activity. Repeated samples are not independent decisions. First 160 endings and 100 pause/resume transitions retained. Pause transitions are observed at tick boundaries; same-tick transitions can be missed, and lost-progress counts are lower bounds.
